messages:
maya liu: Heads-up: found a pattern of missing audit events across services. Quick sync? @aj @irina :eyes:
aj patel: Yep saw that in logs — runtime is missing `token_revoked` events, billing missing `invoice.create`, gateway missing upstream auth decision events
irina kovacs: Can we capture concrete examples? Customer reported admin role changes not showing up in console audit log
leo nguyen: Ran a 24h sample: api-gateway: ~412 missing `auth.decision` events; auth svc: ~37 sessions without `session.create`; billing: 5 failed invoice writes with no audit entry
maya liu: thx @leo. Hypothesis: recent RBAC change (PR #4592) altered the emission path. Also KMS envelope rotation last week may have blocked telemetry writes for a short window
samir singh: I can reproduce console role-change missing: UI shows role update, backend 200, `auditlog.write` returned 202 then never persisted -> trace id abc123
irina kovacs: Schema mismatch possibility: frontend emits `roleChange` (camelCase) while our schema expects `role.change`. Parser might drop unknown event_type
leo nguyen: Good call. Quick schema snippet I used to validate: ```json
{"event_type":"role.change","actor":{"id":"u123","type":"user"},"target":{"id":"u234","type":"user"}}
```
security-bot: Auto-detected anomaly: increased audit drop rate for service=console between 2025-03-10T03:00Z and 2025-03-10T04:20Z (+18%)
aj patel: Action plan proposal: (1) make reproducible test harness per service that emits known events; (2) add integration tests for schema v2; (3) run KMS envelope replay for the 1h window; (4) triage backlog tickets and assign owners
maya liu: Owners: aj -> api-gateway + runtime, irina -> console + schema, leo -> billing + sampling job, samir -> reproduce & trace plumbing. I'll own tracking and customer comms
samir singh: I'll post repro steps + curl examples to the ticket. e.g. `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"event_type":"roleChange",...}' https://console/api/audit`
aj patel: We should add temporary high-fidelity capture to S3 for 48h: set `audit-debug=true` on canary instances
irina kovacs: Schema change proposal: accept both `roleChange` and `role.change` for 2 weeks and emit deprecation warnings to CT logs
leo nguyen: :thumbsup: creating tickets: INFR-1023 (api-gateway missing auth events), SEC-2045 (schema tolerant parsing), BILL-501 (billing audit backlog), OPS-330 (KMS replay)
maya liu: Customer-facing validation: generate sample "evidence" bundle for affected customers: include request/response traces, audit snapshots, and timeline. Target: EOD tomorrow
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS key ids and rotation timestamps to SEC-2045. Encryption metadata required for compliance pack
aj patel: ETA: canary up tonight, sampling job fix by tomorrow morning. Will ping #support for impacted customer list
samir singh: Also add unit tests for `auditlog.write` retry path — `max_retries` currently 2, suggest 5 for transient KMS errors
maya liu: Recap / next steps: 1) owners assigned, 2) create tickets, 3) run KMS replay, 4) tolerant schema + tests, 5) customer evidence bundle. Sync 10:30 UTC tomorrow. Thanks all :pray:
ops-bot: Scheduled: sync created for 2025-03-11T10:30:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/xxxx
aj patel: Adding logs and sample traces to INFR-1023 now
leo nguyen: I'll prepare the sampling script and share it in the ticket shortly
